international.notes: The Departamento de Relaciones Internacionales e Interuniversitarias (DRII) manages international student mobility and incoming/outgoing academic mobility. The Medicina curriculum includes English-language subjects, but no official source found confirms that a medical subject is delivered in English.

profile_paragraphs: USACH’s Faculty of Medical Sciences was founded in 1993. It includes the Schools of Medicine, Nursing, Midwifery, Physical Activity/Sport/Health, Occupational Therapy and Kinesiology.
The Medicina programme awards the Médico Cirujano professional title and a Licenciado/a en Medicina degree over 14 semesters. The official 2026 admission page lists 40 places.
The supplied official SIES 2026 dataset reports 525 Medicina students, including 50 first-year students, at one campus in the Metropolitana Region.

The faculty’s current clinical-fields page names Hospital Barros Luco Trudeau, Hospital San José and Hospital El Pino. A 2025 faculty report calls Barros Luco a long-standing clinical field for undergraduate and specialist training.

Rheumatology has an identifiable presence through the Inmunología–Reumatología service at Barros Luco Trudeau and several rheumatologist academics in the School of Medicine. I found no official confirmation of a standalone USACH rheumatology specialty programme.
